Scene templates

Source: R/cli_helpers.R
get_template_path.Rd

The templates of manim init (upstream's manim/templates), written in R: Default, Axes and MovingCamera.

Usage

get_template_path()

get_template_names()

add_import_statement(file)

copy_template_files(project_dir, template_name = "Default")

Arguments

file

Path of an R file.

project_dir

Folder to copy into.

template_name

One of get_template_names().

Value

get_template_path() a path; get_template_names() a character vector; the others NULL, invisibly.

Details

  • get_template_path() is the folder of the templates.

  • get_template_names() lists them.

  • copy_template_files(project_dir, template_name) copies the template manim.cfg and the scene, as main.R, into project_dir. Unlike upstream, project_dir has no default, so nothing is written to the working directory unless asked.

  • add_import_statement(file) puts library(manimR) on the first line of file.

Examples

get_template_names()
#> [1] "Axes"         "Default"      "MovingCamera"
d <- tempfile()
dir.create(d)
copy_template_files(d, "Axes")
#> 
#> 	copied manim.cfg
#> 
#> 
#> 	copied main.R
#> 
readLines(file.path(d, "main.R"))
#>  [1] "library(manimR)"                                               
#>  [2] "AxesTemplate <- R6::R6Class(\"AxesTemplate\", inherit = Scene,"
#>  [3] "  public = list("                                              
#>  [4] "    construct = function() {"                                  
#>  [5] "      graph <- Axes("                                          
#>  [6] "        x_range = c(-1, 10, 1),"                               
#>  [7] "        y_range = c(-1, 10, 1),"                               
#>  [8] "        x_length = 9,"                                         
#>  [9] "        y_length = 6,"                                         
#> [10] "        axis_config = list(include_tip = FALSE)"               
#> [11] "      )"                                                       
#> [12] "      labels <- graph$get_axis_labels()"                       
#> [13] "      self$add(graph, labels)"                                 
#> [14] "    }"                                                         
#> [15] "  )"                                                           
#> [16] ")"
